Featured research

Solar physics

Coronal magnetic field modeling

Independent research featured by Astro Lab; outside the senior-research program.

A physics-informed tensorized Fourier neural operator reconstructs coronal magnetic fields from a single boundary layer, with potential applications to solar-flare forecasting.

The paper reports R² = 0.820 and mean relative error 0.326 on simulated fields, with predictions within two seconds. It demonstrates field reconstruction, but does not evaluate flare-forecasting accuracy.
